title: [Core] Implement sharded state loader

experiments.name: sharded_state_model_load
experiments.workload: Arctic model loaded from NVMe at 8x tensor parallelism; new sharded_state loader lets each worker read only its own shard instead of the full checkpoint.
experiments.note: Diff adds ShardedStateLoader + save_sharded_state example/test so a pre-sharded checkpoint is read per worker, skipping the default whole-checkpoint load path. Number source: PR body states a 10x model-loading speedup from NVMe with 8x TP on Arctic; only the ratio is published, no absolute load seconds.

reported.scope: end-to-end model load time of the full Arctic checkpoint from NVMe at 8x tensor parallelism; only a 10x ratio, no absolute seconds, and no small-model number
reported.scale_short: Author gave a 10x load-time ratio for Arctic at 8x TP from NVMe, no absolute seconds. TO MAKE 1:1: time ShardedStateLoader vs default loader on the same large multi-shard checkpoint at matching TP on an NVMe box, recording absolute load seconds.
reported.scale_note: Author published only a ratio (~10x faster NVMe load with 8x TP on Arctic, a very large MoE model), reconstructed here as pct=9.0 against our baseline. The win scales with checkpoint size and TP degree; a small single-worker load will show far less because the whole-checkpoint read it eliminates is small. Direction genuine; magnitude is model/TP/storage dependent.

reported.note: author gave a ratio/percentage only; applied to our reproduced baseline
